zh: 改善智能計算分析書的分頁密度、長者閱讀體驗：以最少但安全的頁數平均分配完整年度資料，不再有只剩一兩行的巨大留白尾頁；跨頁保留表頭與所有現金流資料。
中文短欄名及一般利益表最多每頁16行；英文或較長欄位採每頁最多12行的較保守排版，避免為減頁數而裁切文字。頁數會因資料及語言而不同。
條件明細均衡分頁，簡短的風險提醒可合併到條件尾頁，但所有警示、回報假設和費用說明仍完整顯示。教育保險分析書範例由11頁改善為8頁，年度、IRR及銀行比較仍與原先數據一致。
新增長短欄名、14年及33年現金流、無重複／無漏行、頁首重複表頭、英文溢出、短屏／大字與PDF實際渲染回歸測試。原有計算公式、收益假設、海報與分享格式均不變。
en: Improved analysis-book pagination, balanced complete cash-flow schedules between pages, and eliminated almost-empty final pages without losing years, figures or repeating table headers.

Allow up to 16 rows for compact tables, using a safer 12-row limit for long English labels and descriptions where wrapping needs extra vertical space. Pages may differ by locale and content; no text is silently clipped to reduce page count.

Balanced assumption cards across pages and placed short disclosures after short final assumptions where layout permits. The illustrated education report now uses eight pages instead of eleven, preserving its 14-year cash flows, IRR, bank benchmarks and risk warnings.

Added regression coverage for 14/33-year lossless pagination, repeated headers, wrapped English columns, financial report rendering, large-text interfaces and explicit disclosures. Financial formulas and share formats are unchanged.
